blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO — Stephen Curry is committed to keeping some of the reliable, familiar faces around him on the Golden State Warriors for the stretch run of his career. So, Curry took a pay cut to stay put. At 38, he wants to win now, and add another title to his list before he finishes — and finishes right where it all began as a doubted, undersized point guard — with the Warriors.
